lines.en: My bones creak — don't move.
Dry bones moving!
Chomp chomp, I'm going to eat you!
The sound of rotting footsteps!

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，从我脚下一路拖。
lines.en: The stench of rot drags from my feet.
I have no lungs, yet I still wheeze.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里爬出腐殖的虫子。
lines.en: Rotting insects crawl out of my bones.
Run, the bones are coming!
Rotten footsteps approaching!

lines.zh: 骨缝里塞满灰烬，走一步掉一点。
lines.en: Ash fills my joints; each step sheds a little.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩着自己的碎骨。
lines.en: Every step crunches on my own splintered bone.

lines.zh: 踩在填埋墓园的腐土上，脚往下陷。
lines.en: My feet sink into the rot-soil of the burial yard.

lines.zh: 干枯的骨架在这里休息。
lines.en: Dry skeleton taking a rest here.

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨头上挂着灰尘。
lines.en: Rotting bones covered in dust.
Empty gaze between the dry bones.

lines.zh: 腐化的骨骼发出咯吱声。
lines.en: Rotten bones creaking.
Sleeping dry bones.
Rotten teeth grinding.
Dry bones decaying.
Rotting in silence.
Silence between the bones.
Rotting silence.

lines.zh: 灰烬峭壁的风，吹不散我的臭味。
lines.en: The ash-cliff wind cannot blow away my stench.
Two ribs are broken. No matter.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼在黑暗里低声嗡鸣。
lines.en: The spawner hums softly in the dark.

lines.zh: 腐骨在我怀里慢慢发暖。
lines.en: The rot-bone in my arms slowly warms.
You're right there!
I'm going to watch you!

lines.zh: 你的靴子一动，我就听见了。
lines.en: The moment your boot moves, I hear it.

lines.zh: 你的火把照亮了我的脸。
lines.en: Your torch lights up my face.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手举起来，指甲发黑。
lines.en: I raise a rotting hand, nails black.
Rotten flesh still clings to my bones.

lines.zh: 腐烂的腿也能追你三步。
lines.en: Rotten legs can still chase you three steps.

lines.zh: 我的骨头都被腐烂啃过了。
lines.en: Rot has chewed through these bones already.

lines.zh: 再近一点，腐烂就传给你。
lines.en: Closer, and the rot passes to you.
Fear is mixed into the smell of your sweat.

lines.zh: 活人的热气味，我隔着灰都闻到。
lines.en: I smell living warmth through the ash.

lines.zh: 你身上还有完整的皮肉。
lines.en: You still have whole flesh on you.

lines.zh: 我认得冒险者走路的姿势。
lines.en: I know an adventurer's walk when I see it.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，让我看看你的骨头。
lines.en: Don't run yet; let me see your bones.
Your armor won't stop the rot.
Five seconds—one touch is all I need.

lines.zh: 填埋墓园里从没活人走这么近。
lines.en: No living soul comes this close in the burial yard.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，和当年的我一样。
lines.en: You're shaking, just like I once did.
Your throat still moves. How nice.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那儿最好咬。
lines.en: I'm watching your knees—easiest to bite.
My bones hurt.
Rotting agony.
Can't stand up.
End of the rot.
How long can I hold on?
Rot erodes my will.
Please, save me.
Don't want to move.
The rot crawls out through my bones.
Rot devours my soul.

lines.zh: 看到食物，腐尸发出轻微的沙沙声，露出尖锐的牙齿。
lines.en: With a soft creak, the Rotten Corpse shows sharp teeth, tempted by the food.

lines.zh: 腐尸的骨骼在月光下发出淡淡的蓝色光芒，吸引着猎物。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse glows faintly blue under the moon, drawing in its prey.

lines.zh: 腐尸缓缓移动，企图抓住附近的猎物。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse moves slowly, trying to grab the nearby prey.

lines.zh: 它用腐烂的手指指向你，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: With rotting fingers, it points at you, hissing softly.

lines.zh: 腐尸用它那腐烂的手臂缠住猎物，阻止其逃脱。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse uses its rotting arm to hold the prey, preventing its escape.

lines.zh: 腐尸的眼睛闪烁着微光，似乎在思考如何捕捉你。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse's eyes glow faintly, contemplating how to catch you.

lines.zh: 腐尸的骨骼在腐烂中发出吱吱声，表明它在寻找食物。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse's bones creak as it searches for food.

lines.zh: 腐尸在尸体堆中搜寻，希望能找到什么可以吃的东西。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse searches through the corpses, hoping to find something to eat.

lines.zh: 腐尸用腐烂的手臂抓住你，试图把你拉进它的领地。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse grabs you with its rotting arm, trying to drag you into its territory.

lines.zh: 腐尸的牙齿在腐烂中发出沙沙声，准备扑向猎物。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse's teeth creak as it prepares to pounce on the prey.

lines.zh: 腐尸突然出现，发出一声嘶嘶声，准备攻击。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse suddenly appears, hissing, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 腐尸的骨头撞击在一起，发出沉重的声音，警告着其他生物。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse's bones clatter together, making a heavy sound, warning other creatures.

lines.zh: 腐尸撞上了墙壁，发出断裂的声音，试图继续追踪玩家。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the wall, making a cracking sound, trying to continue its pursuit.

lines.zh: 腐尸与玩家撞在一起，发出腐烂的声音，试图抓住玩家。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the player, making a rotted sound, trying to grab the player.

lines.zh: 腐尸撞上了岩壁，发出轻微的撞击声，但继续前进。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the rocky wall, making a soft clatter, but continues forward.

lines.zh: 腐尸撞上了玩家，发出腐烂的骨头撞击声，试图将你推倒。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the player, making a rotted bone clatter, trying to push you down.

lines.zh: 腐尸与岩壁相撞，发出沉重的声音，但仍试图抓住你。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the rock, making a heavy sound, but still tries to grab you.

lines.zh: 腐尸撞上玩家，发出腐烂的声音，试图抓住你。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the player, making a rotted sound, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 腐尸与玩家碰撞，发出腐烂的声音，试图将其击退。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the player, making a rotted sound, trying to push it back.

lines.zh: 腐尸撞上玩家，发出腐烂的骨头撞击声，试图将其撞倒。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse collides with the player, making a rotted bone clatter, trying to knock it down.

lines.zh: 腐尸发出沉重的撞击声，与另一只腐尸交配。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse makes a heavy clatter, mating with another Rotten Corpse.

lines.zh: 腐尸试图与另一只腐尸交配，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse tries to mate with another Rotten Corpse, hissing softly.

lines.zh: 腐尸发出腐烂的声音，试图吸引配偶。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse makes a rotted sound, trying to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 腐尸用腐烂的肢体缠住另一只腐尸，准备交配。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse uses its rotting limbs to hold another Rotten Corpse, preparing to mate.

lines.zh: 腐尸发出嘶嘶声，与另一只腐尸交配。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse hisses, mating with another Rotten Corpse.

lines.zh: 腐尸的骨头发出吱吱声，与另一只腐尸交配。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse's bones creak, mating with another Rotten Corpse.

lines.zh: 腐尸与另一只腐尸交配，发出腐烂的声音。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse mates with another Rotten Corpse, making a rotted sound.

lines.zh: 腐尸用腐烂的手臂缠住另一只腐尸，准备交配。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse uses its rotting arm to hold another Rotten Corpse, preparing to mate.

lines.zh: 腐尸发出腐烂的声音，与另一只腐尸交配。
lines.en: The Rotten Corpse makes a rotted sound, mating with another Rotten Corpse.

lines.zh: 两具腐尸靠在一起，骨头咯咯响。
lines.en: Two rotten corpses lean together, bones rattling.

lines.zh: 干枯的骨头在风中轻响。
lines.en: Dry bones rattle in the breeze.

lines.zh: 腐尸的干尸发出咯吱声。
lines.en: The rotting corpse creaks.
The hungry rotten corpse stares at you.
The rotten corpse’s bones creak.

lines.zh: 腐尸发出沙哑的呼噜声。
lines.en: The rotten corpse groans.

lines.zh: 腐尸的残骸发出吱吱声。
lines.en: The rotten corpse’s remains creak.
The rotten corpse’s withered skin splits.
The rotten corpse hisses.
The rotten corpse’s eyes glow.
The rotten corpse’s skull turns.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝，腐肉就转向你。
lines.en: You snap a dead twig; the corpse turns to you.
Player, your fate is here.
Adventurer’s scent.
Rotten Corpse locked on.
The rotten corpse’s eyes flicker.
The rotten corpse stares intently.
The rotten corpse’s breathing increases.
The rotten corpse’s bones tighten.
The rotten corpse begins to track.
The rotten corpse sees you as prey.

lines.zh: 腐烂的味道，从你那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of rot drifts over from your side.

lines.zh: 你踩断了我的骨头，别想走。
lines.en: You snapped my bone; you're not leaving.

lines.zh: 在灰烬峭壁，没人能躲过我。
lines.en: On the ash cliffs, no one slips past me.

lines.zh: 你现在是我唯一的食物。
lines.en: You're the only food I have now.
The spawner glows—prey has arrived.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I hear every step you take.
Prepare to gnaw your bones.
The rotten corpse’s teeth aim at you.
The rotten corpse’s claws reach for you.
The rotten corpse’s bones rumble.

lines.zh: 腐尸的嘶嘶声变得更响。
lines.en: The rotten corpse’s hiss grows louder.
The rotten corpse’s bones tighten.
The rotten corpse’s muscles tense.
The rotten corpse’s breathing increases.
The rotten corpse sees you as prey

lines.zh: 腐尸的骸骨即将扑向你。
lines.en: The rotten corpse’s bones are about to pounce.
Ankle first, so you can't run.
The rot will seep in through the wound.

lines.zh: 你抬手护脸，腋下就空了。
lines.en: Guard your face and your side opens.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，那是我的倒计时。
lines.en: My bones rattle—that's my countdown.
One step closer and my teeth reach you.

lines.zh: 我瞄准你握剑的那只手。
lines.en: I aim for the hand that holds your sword.
You've backed to the wall. Perfect.
The rot is already in your blood.

lines.zh: 我等你喘气，那时最好下口。
lines.en: I wait for you to gasp—best moment to bite.

lines.zh: 灰烬迷了你的眼，就是现在。
lines.en: Ash blinds you. Now.
Hisss, you're finished!
Rotting bones to crush you!
Adventurer, you're dead!

lines.zh: 吃掉你的肉，腐烂你的骨！
lines.en: Eat your flesh, rot your bones!
Rotting shadow, devour all!
Curse of rot, here it comes!
Rotten chains, bind you!

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿，碎裂你的骨骼！
lines.en: Rotting teeth, shatter your bones!
Rotting adventure, ends here!
Corrupted being, devour life!
Teeth on skin—the rot begins.

lines.zh: 五秒钟，你的伤口会发黑。
lines.en: Five seconds and your wound goes black.
I gnaw your shoulder, bone and all.

lines.zh: 倒下的冒险者，会变成我。
lines.en: Fallen adventurers become me.
Your blood is warm. A shame.

lines.zh: 这一口，替所有死在这里的人。
lines.en: This bite is for everyone who died here.
Rotting land, I'm here!
Bones within, rotting spirit!
Ash cliff, I'm coming!
Burial grounds, rotting king!
Skeleton awakens, rotting adventure!
Adventurer's bones, rotting rebirth!
Rotting lock, hell's door!
Rotting soul, seek prey!
Rotting source, I rise!
Rotting adventure, never ends!

lines.zh: 灰烬峭壁上，我撑起脊背。
lines.en: On the ash cliffs I raise my spine.

lines.zh: 填埋墓园松了土，我钻出来。
lines.en: The burial yard loosens, and I claw out.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼转了一圈，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The spawner turns once, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 谁把骨头丢在这里？正好。
lines.en: Who left these bones here? Perfect.
My flesh rotted away long ago.

lines.zh: 从尸堆里站起来，关节作响。
lines.en: I rise from the corpse pile, joints cracking.

lines.zh: 失落文明的冒险者，又醒一个。
lines.en: Another adventurer of the lost civilization wakes.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风把我吹活了。
lines.en: The bone-waste wind blows me awake.
Rot-bone back in place—now I'm whole.

lines.zh: 地下太安静，我上来找你。
lines.en: Down there it's too quiet. I came up for you.
Fire burns my bones.
Fall impact.

lines.zh: 水灌进胸腔，腐烂被冲淡。
lines.en: Water fills my chest and dilutes the rot.
Exploded my skin.

lines.zh: 骨头做的身体，箭一穿就过。
lines.en: A body of bone — the arrow goes right through.
Magic tore through me.
Starvation weakens me.
Lightning shows the holes inside my bones.

lines.zh: 骨头上最后一点肉也被扯走。
lines.en: The last flesh on my bones is torn away.
